limits.name: Gravity
limits.text: About 0.17 g on the Moon versus 1 g on Earth

limits.name: Atmosphere
limits.text: Essentially a vacuum: no wind, no weathering by air, no air to carry heat

limits.name: Radiation
limits.text: No thick air and no global magnetic field to shield the surface

limits.name: Temperature
limits.text: 54 °C in sunlight to −203 °C in shadowed craters (NASA Moon Base page); Earth’s record low is about −89 °C

limits.name: Gravity
limits.text: About 0.38 g on Mars versus 1 g on Earth

limits.name: Atmosphere
limits.text: About 1% as dense as Earth's (NASA JPL), mostly carbon dioxide

limits.name: Radiation
limits.text: Thin air and no global magnetic field to shield the surface

limits.name: Water
limits.text: Liquid water is not stable on the surface today; Earth analogs always hold some moisture
